bio: Marni Lynn von Wilpert (born December 27, 1982) is an American attorney and politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for California's 48th congressional district.
offices: Member of the San Diego City Council (2020–present)

items.t: Co-sponsored an ordinance requiring grocery stores with digital-only coupons to make the same discounts available to all customers in-store.
items.q: von Wilpert co-sponsored an ordinance which required grocery stores with digital-only coupons to make the same discounts available to all customers in-store.

items.t: Voted for a 2023 city council ordinance permitting police to remove homeless encampments on public property if city shelter beds were available (5–4 vote).
items.q: Von Wilpert voted for a city council ordinance in 2023 that permitted police to remove homeless encampments on public property if city shelter beds were available, which passed in a 5–4 vote.
